_comment: OPENING template for the Spanish half of the data-use demo flow.
This is hand-written rather than generated, unlike everything in
templates/generated/, because it is the one message in the flow that Meta
reviews and it is worth reading word by word before it is frozen. It is
also the only template here that is ever submitted: consent and all four
ARM 2 questions are sent inside the 24-hour window the reply to this
message opens, so they need no approval at all.
Copy matches the `intro` widget that scripts/build_data_use_demo.py emits
for Spanish. Submission is irreversible - Meta has no edit operation - so
review it here first.
Framed for UTILITY, not MARKETING. It names the event the participant is
already attending and states plainly what will happen, with no persuasion
and no incentive. Every approved opening on this account that led with
excitement or a reward landed in MARKETING, which carries per-user limits
and worse delivery. See
.claude/skills/whatsapp-template/references/ipa-examples.md.
The quick-reply button matters mechanically, not just for tone: the flow's
intro widget is send-and-wait-for-reply, so tapping Empezar is what opens
the 24-hour window and lets every later message be free-form - including
the list pickers, which cannot open a session themselves.
'confidenciales' is a claim the pipeline actually keeps - encrypt_fields
encrypts name and phone before anything is stored.

twilio/quick-reply.body:
Hola {{1}}, te damos la bienvenida a la sesión sobre encuestas por WhatsApp.

Durante la sesión participarás en una encuesta corta - y también harás parte del ejemplo.

Toma unos 3 minutos. Tus respuestas son confidenciales y solo se usarán para ilustrar la recolección de datos por WhatsApp durante la sesión.

Toca Empezar cuando estés listo.
